extracted.intended_audience: authors and methodologists preparing Cochrane systematic reviews of interventions
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and maintaining Cochrane systematic reviews of healthcare interventions, covering standard review methods (planning, searching, selection, data collection, bias assessment, analysis, GRADE) and a range of specialised topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in the Handbook as part of the standard methods applicable to every review. All authors should consult the Handbook for guidance on planning Cochrane systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching and selecting studies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as a core standard method applicable to every review; guidance covers how to design and execute searches and how to select studies for inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data collection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook provides guidance on data collection methods for reviews, including what to extract and how to manage collected study data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk of bias assessment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes methods for assessing risk of bias in included studies — a standard method applicable to every review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical analysis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on statistical analysis of review data, including meta-analysis methods and appropriate analytic approaches for different data types.

rubrics_metrics.name: GRADE and interpreting results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers use of GRADE to assess certainty of evidence and guidance on interpreting and presenting review results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-randomized studies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a specialised topic in the Handbook; provides methods for incorporating and assessing non-randomized evidence in intervention reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adverse effects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included as a specialised topic with guidance on identifying, extracting, and synthesising data on harms and adverse events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complex interventions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialised guidance on handling interventions with multiple interacting components, context dependence, and complexity in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook includes specialised guidance on considering equity issues in systematic reviews (e.g., differential effects across populations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Economics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialised topic guidance on economic evidence and methods for incorporating cost and resource-use data into reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-reported outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on identification, measurement, and synthesis of patient-reported outcome measures in intervention reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual patient data (IPD)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook provides specialised methods for undertaking and integrating individual patient data meta-analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospective meta-analysis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes guidance on planning and conducting prospective meta-analyses (pre-specified, collaborative pooling of data across studies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialised guidance on the role, appraisal, and synthesis of qualitative evidence relevant to intervention reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR) — core standards that are generally expected of Cochrane reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key aspects of Handbook guidance are collated as MECIR; each MECIR item includes a link to the relevant Handbook chapter and represents core standards for conduct and reporting of Cochrane intervention reviews.
